items.raw_excerpt: Mobile phones are now banned at Kanaka Durga temple in Vijayawada, with new security measures for devotees' safety.

items.raw_excerpt: It is just one of 100 of the handmade album covers ever created by the elusive artist.
items.summary_en: One of only 100 handmade album covers made by artist Banksy has sold for thousands of pounds. The elusive artist made each cover by hand. Collectors paid a high price for this rare record.

items.raw_excerpt: An Co Wicklow solar physicist has described partaking in an aerial mission to record images of eclipse as the highlight of her career.
items.summary_en: A solar physicist from County Wicklow took part in an aerial mission to capture images of an eclipse. She said the flight was the highlight of her career.

items.raw_excerpt: A Christchurch woman who struggled for years with chronic pain and opioid addiction says an ADHD diagnosis and medication changed her life.
items.summary_en: A Christchurch woman lived with chronic pain and opioid addiction for years. An ADHD diagnosis and medication changed her life. She says she was like a zombie before.

items.raw_excerpt: Ein eigens produzierter Film, ein Dorffest und ein Zwetschgenkuchen-Märit: Am 13. September findet rund um die reformierte Kirche der «Konolfinger Bettag» statt. Ergänzt wird der Anlass durch Musik und Angebote für Kinder.

items.raw_excerpt: A ceramics studio in Tijuana is leaning into Mexican animal mythology for its otherworldly interior designs.
items.summary_en: A ceramics studio in Tijuana uses Mexican animal mythology for its interiors. The designs come from desert animals. The work brings local culture into home design.

items.raw_excerpt: There is a version of conservation that gets all the attention. Pandas. Baby seals. Anything with big eyes and soft fur. And then there is the version that Martina Panisi has built her life around — the 97% of the animal kingdom that nobody is fighting to save.
items.summary_en: Martina Panisi is a conservationist who works to save small and overlooked animals. While cute pandas and seals get all the attention, she focuses on the 97 percent of the animal kingdom that nobody fights for. Her work celebrates these small creatures and their big importance.
items.summary_ko: 보존 전문가 마르티나 파니시는 아무도 구하려 하지 않는 작고 소외된 동물들을 위해 일하고 있습니다. 귀여운 팬더나 바다표범이 주목받는 동안, 그녀는 동물계의 97퍼센트를 차지하는 작은 생물들에 집중합니다. 그녀의 일은 작은 생물들이 지닌 큰 가치를 조명합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Ernakulam-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Express will increase from eight to 16 coaches, addressing growing commuter demand.
items.summary_en: The Ernakulam-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Express will grow from eight to sixteen coaches. The change will help handle more commuters. Many travelers will now get seats on the popular route.
